external_boundary.treatment: No supported current operator exists for these conductors (GH returns, EL rail harnesses, JL/JR/P main branches). They are external boundaries of the KA-KB subnetwork: their current is not injected, and the 0.5 A GH conductor condition is NOT EVALUATED here. Patch sleeves are not counted as returns.

scope: KA-KB subnetwork only: KA and KB core copper, CS247 W1-W6 bulk once, each termination once, conditional KA main-land source support. Excludes inlet/star/protection copper, JL/JR/P/EL branches, GH/harness and patch returns.

scenario.injected: supported_pin_current and conditional_assumption records with a numeric current on a pad of this board/net
scenario.not_injected: external_interface_demand (EL group ceiling: no per-pad split is supported), unmapped_allowance, and every no_amount record
scenario.producer: python3 load_ledger.py --output DIR (deterministic; --check rebuilds and compares)

entries.error_convention: error_V = (V_rail(pad) - V_AGND(local ground)) - (V_rail(source) - V_AGND(source)); both nets are referenced to 0 V at the source, so error_V = V_rail(pad) - V_AGND(local). It is the deviation of the supply voltage the device actually sees, signed; on -12V a local ground rise partly cancels a rail rise. The additive magnitude screen in power/joined/handoff.md (|rail drop| + |ground rise|) is reported alongside as a conservative bound.
entries.gh_conductor_condition: NOT EVALUATED: no GH conductor or GH return current is in this KA-KB model

budgets.source: design/partition/core-split/power/contract.json conductor_screen.global_budget and power/joined/handoff.md: one global 20 mV path allowance, 1 mOhm rail and 0.5 mOhm common AGND copper, never restarted per board; 0.5 A per GH conductor.
budgets.application: Charged once over the modelled KA+wire+KB path; the unmodelled inlet/star, branch and protection copper must fit in the same allowance, so a modelled value within budget is necessary, not sufficient.

limits: Conditional: process (foil, plating, rho), stack depths, wire/termination requirement values and the source support are declared assumptions, not qualified values.

Loads: only datasheet-supported op-amp quiescent and conditional logic supply currents are injected; most fitted-IC supply current, all output/signal current and the EL demand are unmapped and not injected, so voltages are a lower-load study, not a worst case.
A modelled value within a requirement is necessary, not sufficient: the unmodelled inlet/star/branch copper shares the same global allowance.
P1 finite elements on the exact clipped copper; conforming discretisation tends to underestimate resistance; refinement and shifted-origin changes are reported separately.
